claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b090] Scope decisions for this batch (both files, per instrument rule 5): dates and timestamps (2026-04-22, 2026-05-02/03, 2026-04-19 …), git commit hashes (`8747d726`, `731466d8`, `e07dae37`, `e3aef6fa`, `a9e280a3`, `7f05f529`, `ad023fc3`), Observation identifiers (Obs 255, 256–273, 318/319), errata identifiers (E47, E52, E54), working-notes line-number citations (line 12840, lines 115–117, line 37, :1670), phase identifiers (phase 2 + 3), hypothesis/condition names (h8, h10, h11, h12-v2, Era 1 / Era 2, `pv-diag`-style labels), version strings (v1, v2, D-S v1/v2), and numbers inside file paths or run names (`55maps_text_high_generalisation`, `single-pass-384-UNINTENDED-T1.0`, `results-audit-2026-04-21.md`, `buffer-100m-diagnostics`) are all OUT of scope. Ordinal markers on numbered lists ("1.", "2.", "3.") are formatting, not claims. Numerals that assert the cardinality of study entities ("two distinct runs", "all four 55-map runs", "three bugs", "100 files") ARE extracted; purely anaphoric back-references ("the prior audit conflated the two", audit-summary.md line 84) are not, since the same cardinality is already captured from the span that asserts it. "55-map" and "4-map" are treated per instrument rule 5's name-and-fact clause: they are extracted as corpus-size counts wherever the surrounding span is substantively about those runs. Anchoring: this is an audit document whose stated sources are overwhelmingly OTHER markdown documents (`planning/doc-audit-rerun-plan.md`, `configs/run-configs/*_post_run_report.md`, `docs/notes/reflections/working-notes.md`, `results/ci-metadata-registry.md`, `results/documentation-audit/results-audit-2026-04-21.md`), which instrument rule 2 forbids anchoring to; wherever a committed JSON/YAML/CSV artefact could be located behind the citation it is used instead, and where none exists the claim is `anchor-unknown` with the chased-but-unresolved target named. For THIS claim: the two-agent workflow is described only in `planning/doc-audit-rerun-plan.md` (prose); no manifest or config records an agent count. Included despite being a workflow rather than a study quantity, per the instrument's include-when-in-doubt rule.
